facts.text: The hotel sits in the harbourside village of Double Bay, a short distance from Sydney's CBD.
facts.excerpt: Tucked within the harbourside village of Double Bay, our hotel offers a peaceful retreat just a short distance from the CBD.

facts.text: The hotel is on Double Bay's main shopping strip.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Sydney Double Bay occupies prime real estate on Double Bay’s main shopping strip.

facts.text: The hotel's white facade has balconies and arched windows overlooking leafy trees.
facts.excerpt: Its large but fairly low-key white façade suits the "urban village" vibe of this upscale Eastern Suburbs neighbourhood, with balconies and arched windows overlooking leafy trees.

facts.text: Some rooms look out over the bay, some over the neighbourhood, and others onto a French-style courtyard.
facts.excerpt: The bay glimmers through some windows, its mood changing with the light. Some look down over the neighbourhood, while others open onto a tucked-away French-style courtyard.

facts.text: Many rooms have private balconies or courtyards.
facts.excerpt: Private balconies and courtyards up the indulgence in many rooms.

facts.text: Some rooms look over Sydney Harbour and Double Bay's marina.
facts.excerpt: Let your gaze linger over Sydney Harbour and the gentle shimmer of Double Bay’s marina.

facts.text: Bathrooms are in polished Italian marble with double basins and a separate bath and shower.
facts.excerpt: Polished Italian marble bathrooms offer double basins and a separate bath and shower, ideal for couples.

facts.text: The hotel has one outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Sydney Double Bay has 1 outdoor pool.

facts.text: The outdoor pool has great views of Sydney Harbour.
facts.excerpt: Great views of Sydney Harbour

facts.text: The Upper Bar is framed by sweeping harbour views.
facts.excerpt: The Upper Bar invites you to pause and take it all in. Framed by sweeping harbour views, it is a place where conversations flow easily

facts.text: The Bar draws inspiration from the great hotel bars of London, Rome, Paris and New York.
facts.excerpt: Drawing inspiration from the great hotel bars of London, Rome, Paris, and New York, this space is a tribute to timeless sophistication and glamour.

facts.text: The Upper Bar serves high tea by day.
facts.excerpt: At The Upper Bar, casual plates meet the sky. By day, the bar invites you to savour the delicate layers of high tea

facts.text: Bayside Bistro and Bar pours beers on tap, cocktails and wines.
facts.excerpt: Behind the bar, discover a curated selection of beers on tap, cocktails, and well chosen wines.

facts.text: The hotel is proudly pet friendly.
facts.excerpt: We are a proudly pet friendly hotel.

facts.text: The hotel has on-site EV charging stations.
facts.excerpt: Stay powered and connected with our on-site EV charging stations

facts.text: Redleaf Beach is about 0.5 kilometres from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Redleaf Beach - 0.31 miles away (0.5 kilometers)

facts.text: At Redleaf Beach, Murray Rose Pool offers a safe harbour swimming area.
facts.excerpt: take a swim in Murray Rose Pool which provides swimmers with a safe swimming area.

facts.text: The Sydney Opera House is about 4.8 kilometres from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Sydney Opera House - 2.98 miles away (4.8 kilometers)

facts.text: Just beyond the hotel, guests can wander past storefronts, linger at waterside cafes or follow the coastline to stretches of sand.
facts.excerpt: Wander past charming storefronts, linger at waterside cafés, or follow the coastline to stretches of sand.

facts.text: The Dining Room's breakfast buffet includes artisan breads from Baker Bleu.
facts.excerpt: Artisan breads from Baker Bleu and seasonal fruits add a gentle balance of flavour.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a tranquil retreat where coastal calm meets refined luxury.
facts.excerpt: discover a tranquil retreat where coastal calm meets refined luxury.
